description: Use this when someone asks when their Saturn return is (in Vedic, sidereal reckoning), whether they are in it now, or at what ages it comes. Also use for "Saturn return at 28/29" and Shani return. Returns every Saturn return with dates and ages. Needs birth date and town; ask if missing.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

name: saturn_return_dates
title: Saturn return dates
